790450101.text: Staff and equipment in position. Mechanisms are prepped and ready.

790450102.text: This performance of "The Black Nacre and the All-Devouring Kraken," a play from "Daiya's Three-Day Reverie," will now begin!

790450103.text: Docked in the port closest to the rumored location of the treasure, the crew of the pirate ship "Black Nacre" is recruiting new sailors and restocking before the final and most crucial leg of the voyage...

790450104.text: Experienced adventurers set foot on the deck of the Black Nacre. They're outstanding fighters, but novice sailors...

790450105.text: Ahoy there, landlubbers! Get on over here!

790450106.text: Huh? The voice from the speaker changed. It sounds like someone really serious is calling us...

790450107.text: So, it's trying to interact with us?

790450108.text: Who else would I be talking to? You're the best out of this sorry bunch of scallywags, we can't set sail without you!

790450109.text: I'm the Chief Mate of the Black Nacre! You'll be working with me on this voyage, savvy?

790450110.text: Perk up, sailors! It's your first day on deck, and our quartermaster will make sure you get the best preserved meat, cream, hardtack, and Dandelion Wine!

790450111.text:
The speaker continues to narrate the scene before you—

The Chief Mate appears to greet the raw recruits, dressed in ragged clothes and swaddled in bandages.
It is obvious that he has just survived a fierce fight.
Looking around, you see most of the sailors are seriously wounded...
However, they are in high spirits, showing no signs of fear or being discouraged...
The sailors gather around you, applauding the newcomers and offering welcome gifts and food.

790450112.text: Oh! So the speaker also provides detailed narration of the scene, like the scene just now — we were just welcomed onboard the Black Nacre...

790450114.text: Hehe, thank you, thank you everyone! We haven't had the preserved meat or hardtack here yet, but they must be tasty!

790450117.text: Yeah... the attraction is called "Three-Day Reverie," so are we just supposed to rely on our own powers of daydreaming?

790450118.text: Though, it probably does save a lot on costs... Building a real pirate ship, actually being able to sail anywhere at a moment's notice... That must be expensive...

790450119.text: But still! Only having a narrator is too far. We can only imagine so much!

790450801.text: Marvelous! Congratulations! With the strength of the new sailors, Captain Will easily defeats his old enemies, sending them running.

790450802.text: Having overcome every challenge the voyage could throw at them, nothing can stop the crew of the Black Nacre now!

790450803.text: Such is the loyal crew of the Black Nacre, me lads! Even when those lily-livered biscuit eaters ambushed us, not one of you panicked...

790450804.text: And of course, our newest crewmembers contributed mightily! They swept away all opposition like it was so much flotsam and jetsam!

790450805.text: #Of course! Bad pirates like that? Paimon and {NICKNAME} could fight two or three boatloads more!

790450808.text: I—It's okay! The journey was pretty thrilling, and we've been through thick and thin with Captain Will. So Paimon can be a bit more serious!

790450809.text: Based on our research, if we break that stone wall, we can find the legendary treasure.

790450810.text: The crucial moment has arrived. I shall give the honor to our heroes, our new companions!

790450811.text: And after that, I've got a new idea I'd like to discuss with all of you...

790450812.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! See how much the Captain values us? He's even letting us handle something as important as this!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location of the hidden treasure

790451001.text: Yay! We found it! The legendary treasure! So much Mora, Paimon can really swim in it!

790451002.text: But, why does this Mora seem different from the Mora we usually see? Don't tell Paimon...

790451003.text: Hey! The legendary "pool of Mora" is actually just a bunch of decorative fake coins!?

790451004.text: Faced with such an unexpected development, what will the crew of the Black Nacre do?

790451005.text: Captain! We were hornswoggled! Could our intel have been wrong? The legendary treasure... how could it all be fake?

790451006.text: No wonder I had a bad feeling about this.

790451007.text: The so-called legendary treasure could be bait— luring us into a trap.

790451008.text: And their goal: the very people who braved hell and high water in search of treasure... and the quality weapons and advanced ships they bring with them.

790451009.text: The sailors, exhausted by the journey, can easily be captured and sold as labor.

790451010.text: No, NO! We were all tricked! How could this be a giant trap!?

790451013.text: Oh! Uh... you have a point. Paimon forgot we were acting...

790451014.text: Okay, even though there aren't any other actors, and the set is a bit shabby, Paimon can tell a lot of work went into this! Paimon thinks we should respect that.

790451015.text: Let's hear what our crewmates from the Black Nacre have to say!

790451016.text: Captain Will gathers the inconsolable sailors in front of the fake treasure.

790451017.text: Captain, is this... is this the doing of your enemies?

790451018.text: No, this is beyond them. If we didn't make it, they'd be disappointed in their old foe.

790451019.text: Perhaps... the ones behind this are on their way here now. Given our current state, it wouldn't be wise to take them head on.

790451020.text: Clean up the area, see if there are any chests we missed, and get ready to withdraw.

790451021.text: Ho! I always said hard work is rewarded. See that chest over there? It's for our newest sailors, who've done so much! No arguing, it's theirs even if the rest of us go home empty-handed!

790451022.text: Ugh... Not only did we not make any money, we racked up a lot of losses!

790451023.text: What're we going to do? Keep searching for dishonest profiteers to try and scrape together enough booty to satisfy the Kraken?

790451024.text: I was about to point out that on this voyage, we of the Black Nacre found a treasure more precious than Mora, and are not going back with nothing to show for it!

790451025.text: We found the ways to cross the roaring seas, strategies to defeat our enemies, and the courage to face any challenge!

790451026.text: Think about it, me buckos! Even if we found an ocean of Mora, would it really buy peace for our town?

790451028.text: We all know how greedy the Kraken is. No matter how much treasure we shove down its filthy gob, it'll always ask for seconds!

790451029.text: Aye, he's right. I've heard even rich towns have given it dozens of times more treasure than we, yet still it hungers.
